summary: Air-date lane only. Ep 36's stored 2007-06-19 is CORRECT for our house convention; the regression is caused by ep 35, whose stored 2008-06-12 is a YEAR corruption — the day and month are right. Death Note ran a weekly NTV Tuesday 24:56 slot, so ep 34 = Tue 2007-06-05, ep 35 = Tue 2007-06-12, ep 36 = Tue 2007-06-19, ep 37 = Tue 2007-06-26 in the nominal-Tuesday convention our rows use. One repair, no true deviation.

repairs.why: syoboi TID 945 Count 35 = 2007-06-13 00:56 (NTV), i.e. the Tuesday 2007-06-12 24:56 broadcast; en-WP Death Note (2006 TV series) episode table gives ep 35 'Malice' = 2007-06-13 under the post-midnight convention. Our rows 34/36/37 store the nominal Tuesday (06-05 / 06-19 / 06-26), so the value consistent with them is 2007-06-12. The series ended 2007-06-27; 2008 is impossible.

structure.notes: 37 rows = 第1話–第37話, 1:1 with en-WP. No recaps or specials in the row space.

flags_for_sean: Convention note (whole series, not a single-row defect): our per-episode Death Note dates are the NOMINAL Tuesday, one day earlier than syoboi/en-WP, which print the post-midnight Wednesday (NTV 24:56). Verified at rows 34, 36, 37. Meanwhile the series-level start (2006-10-04) and the en-WP end (2007-06-27) use the Wednesday convention — the two fields are inconsistent with each other. Worth a whole-series normalisation decision, out of scope for one row.
